sql: SELECT 'O' k, market_ticker t, side||'/'||action||'/'||status s, limit_price::text p, quantity::text q, coalesce(cancel_reason,'') r, created_at::text at, client_order_id c FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND created_at > now()-interval '30 hours' AND market_ticker LIKE '%DRA26DEC%' UNION ALL SELECT 'F', f.market_ticker, f.side||'/'||f.action, f.price::text, f.quantity::text, f.fee::text, f.filled_at::text, coalesce(f.raw_fill_json::json->>'created_time','') FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id WHERE o.strategy='Alimm1' AND f.market_ticker LIKE '%DRA26DEC%' AND f.filled_at > now()-interval '3 hours' UNION ALL SELECT 'S', market_ticker, coalesce(best_yes_bid::text,'')||'/'||coalesce(best_no_bid::text,''), '', coalesce(trades_last_5m::text,''), '', at::text, '' FROM incentive_market_snapshots WHERE market_ticker LIKE '%DRA26DEC-1%' AND at > '2026-11-03 21:40' AND at < '2026-11-03 22:20' ORDER BY 1,7
